text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we were about to begin a meeting 
in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just a little since this morning. 
When this happens, even the lighting hurts 
my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, please pardon me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's a bit better. Now, let's start the 
meeting.
choice_data_list:
...If it's that tough, shall we do it 
another time?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. ...However, 
today's meeting is crucial for the 
upcoming race, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking my medicine, so I'm sure it 
will get better. I'd be glad if you let me 
continue like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Almond Eye headed into the meeting 
while battling a headache.
